user.title: Sign in to Autobayt
user.description: Use the email and password of your Autobayt app account. Home Assistant keeps only the sign-in token, not your password.

data_description.host: Only change this if Autobayt gave you a different server address.

location.title: Choose a home
location.description: Pick the Autobayt location to add. Add the integration again for another location.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Autobayt again
reauth_confirm.description: Autobayt no longer accepts the saved sign-in for {location}. Enter your password again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Autobayt server.

abort.no_locations: This Autobayt account has no locations.
abort.wrong_account: That is a different Autobayt account than the one this location was added with.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to ask Autobayt for switch states, in seconds.
data_description.shutter_models: Comma-separated model names to treat as shutters, if a shutter shows up as switches.
data_description.energy: Show power and today's energy for power-metering (PM) devices.
data_description.energy_timezone: IANA time zone that decides when the day starts, for example Asia/Amman.
